wholePhysicalScope: Named OpenStreetMap relation 7318379 has an 18-point outer footprint and a four-point open court, fixing the terrace extent and direction. Gurlitt’s published plan identifies the single large dome flanked by three bays per side, the seven central porch bays, fountain and court cells.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the single Ottoman dome, minaret, seven-bay porch and open madrasa court. Near levels show the window arrays, striped arches and stone basin.
limitations: The surviving restored silhouette uses the documented single slender minaret. Its height, rear roof lines, lead roofing tones, window lattices and courtyard paving are approximations derived from the published references.
The model follows the named mosque compound. The distinct hammam, historic city wall, interiors and surrounding independent buildings are outside its footprint.
